items.title: Kenny Barron — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Stan and I, with the quartet, sometimes he would end a set with this song that we played duo... You two guys should do a duo recording. So I guess he took it to heart. He hooked it up.

ctx.x: But it definitely put – people talk about that record. Do you want to talk about that record too?
It was a great record. When we did it – it came about because Stan and I, with the quartet, sometimes he would end a set with this song that we played duo, called Yours and Mine. No, People Time.
People Time is the name of it.
